function: Learned joint allocation of RSMA stream powers, common-rate split and OIRS element-to-receiver association, maximizing effective rate and minimizing effective power (p. 3, Eqs. 5-6, 13).
system: Single-LED transmitter, K (2 or 6) single-photodiode receivers, reflecting passive OIRS with N=4 to 36 elements, visible light, 5x5x3 m room (pp. 2, 4, 5).
method: Meta-learning A3C (MA3C) deep reinforcement learning, actor-critic with parallel asynchronous actors; meta-training over tasks, then meta-adaptation with a batch (p. 4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Lambertian LoS plus OIRS NLoS model, random receiver positions, bounded CSI error; no standardized channel, measured data or public dataset (pp. 2, 5).
test_conditions: Training: 5000 episodes of 200 steps (p. 4). Testing: perfect vs imperfect CSI, sweeping R_min, rho (0.7, 0.9), N and K; held-out conditions not stated (p. 5).
baselines: Learned: A3C (no meta-learning) and DDPG; SDMA as multiple-access benchmark; no classical or non-learned allocation baseline (p. 5, Fig. 2).
metrics: Average reward, total rate R_tot (bps/Hz), total power P_tot (dBm), per-receiver rate and power for fairness (pp. 4-5, Fig. 2).
q1_support: p. 2: "based on the Lambertian model". Custom VLC simulator (Eqs. 1-3, bounded CSI error); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "MA3C maintains robustness due to its meta-learning-based adaptability". No test on a scenario held out from training is reported: IPCSI is only a bounded CSI error (p. 2) and the sweeps of R_min, rho, N and K are not stated to be unseen.
q3_support: p. 5: "significantly outperforms both A3C and DDPG". Only learned baselines: A3C is the method without meta-learning (an ablation), DDPG is compared on reward convergence; no non-learned baseline (SCA, fixed OIRS) is simulated.
q4_support: p. 2: "our proposed scheme is real-time". Qualitative claim only; the paper gives no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime (Table II on p. 4 lists only layer sizes 2/128, 128).
q5_support: p. 5: "The optical channel parameters as well as learning parameters are summarized in Table II". Own simulation parameters only; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 3: the agent sets OIRS element-to-receiver association and RSMA stream powers (p. 3, Eq. 13) in a visible-light system with an optical IRS (p. 2, Fig. 1). Links are single-LED and single-PD, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply because a RIS is present; reviewer to confirm that an optical IRS in VLC is in scope. q2 is borderline: the meta-adaptation phase is described (p. 4, Eq. 23) and p. 1 claims adaptation to unseen or perturbed CSI, but no held-out conditions are reported and CSI-error sweeps do not count. q3: A3C is an ablation of MA3C; SDMA is a multiple-access scheme whose allocation method is not stated; SCA in Table I (p. 3) is related work only. q4: Table II was read from the page image (p. 4) and lists only network sizes. Title on page 1 matches the DOI.
